insight: Raised a $300M Series E in June 2025 at a $5.3B valuation, roughly doubling its worth in four months (a16z-led).
name: Abridge
tagline: Ambient AI that turns clinician-patient conversations into billable clinical notes.
description: Abridge uses ambient listening to capture clinician-patient conversations and generate structured, billable clinical notes in real time, integrating with EHRs like Epic and Athena. Every note section links back to the source transcript and audio so clinicians can verify details. It is sold to health systems rather than individuals.
edge: Best in KLAS for Ambient AI two years running, with the deepest Epic integration and per-line transcript linkage.
pros: Every note line links to source audio
Deep Epic and Athena EHR integration
Real-time note generation during the visit
cons: Enterprise-only; no self-serve for solo clinicians
Epic now ships a competing native scribe

references.title: Do Ambient Scribe Startups Have a Future Now That Epic Launched Its Own Tool?
